columns.name: METERING_EXPR_ID
columns.description: Unique rowid of the metering expression

columns.name: METERING_EXPR_PUID
columns.description: The name of this metering expression

columns.name: EXPR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the metering expression

columns.name: OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operator of the expression

columns.name: EXPR_VALUE
columns.description: value of the expression

columns.name: METERING_VAL_UPPER_RANGE
columns.description: Indicates the upper range value of the expression when the operator is 'between'

columns.name: METERING_VAL_LOWER_RANGE
columns.description: Indicates the lower range value of the expression when the operator is between

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the  type of value used in the expression like STRING,NUMBER etc.

columns.name: RANGE_INTERVAL_CODE
columns.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the upper range and lower range values. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

columns.name: ELIGIBILITY_PARAM_CODE
columns.description: Indicates type of eligibility parameter  used in the rules

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the entity name of the entity which can be another metering expression or metering rule

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: association with entity

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the (class) of metering expression

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the base (class) of metering expression

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
